text:
Bangladesh dengue fever update - by Robert Herriman 
 Subscribe Sign in Indian subcontinent Bangladesh dengue fever update
 Robert Herriman Nov 04, 2026 Share Six more people died from dengue in the past 24 hours, while 1,866 new patients were admitted to hospitals across the country during the same period, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 A total of 142,775 people have been hospitalised with dengue across the country between January 1 and November 4 this year.
 20 Mosquito-borne diseases 
 Of the newly hospitalised patients, 868 were from Dhaka division, 66 from Mymensingh, 256 from Chattogram, 215 from Khulna, 171 from Rajshahi, 71 from Rangpur, 206 from Barishal and 13 from Sylhet.
 With the latest fatalities, the total number of deaths from dengue this year has reached 445.
